meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容自动整理成规格并提交到问题系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把零散讨论变成可执行的规格
copy.tagline_en: Turn conversation into a spec and publish to issue tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to convert discussions into actionable specs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把当前对话内容和代码库理解综合成一份 spec（类似 PRD），直接发布到项目 issue tracker，并打上 ready-for-agent 标签；不会向你提问。
howto.when: 当用户要求把当前对话整理成 spec 并发布到项目 issue tracker 时触发；需先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills 提供 issue tracker 和标签词汇。

say.note: 将生成模板化的 spec 并发布。

say.text: 按模板把这个功能写成 PRD，标记 ready-for-agent

say.text: 不用采访我，直接综合对话生成 spec 发到项目里

howto.what_en: Claude takes the current conversation and codebase understanding, synthesizes them into a spec (a PRD-like document), and publishes it to the project's issue tracker with the ready-for-agent triage label, without interviewing the user.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker. The issue tracker and label vocabulary should be set up via /setup-matt-pocock-skills if not already provided.

say_en.text: Turn our discussion into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker.
say_en.note: Generates and publishes a template-based spec.

say_en.text: Write this feature as a PRD using the template and mark it ready-for-agent.
say_en.note: Applies the template and adds the triage label.

say_en.text: Don't interview me—just synthesize the conversation into a spec and post it.
